teams.name: Seattle Seahawks
teams.note: Seattle takes the top spot after holding the Chiefs to 3 points in a 20-3 win. The defense (+2.4 points) is doing the work, while the offense sits at just +0.1 points. Chicago visits next.

teams.name: San Francisco 49ers
teams.note: The 49ers stay at #2 even after a 29-20 loss to the Falcons. At 6-1 with a 95% playoff chance, they host the Raiders in week 9, favored by 12.2.

teams.name: Buffalo Bills
teams.note: Buffalo slid two spots without playing, coming off a bye at 5-1. The offense is the engine at +4.7 points, and the defense is the soft spot at -1.1. Baltimore comes to town.

teams.name: Los Angeles Rams
teams.note: The Rams are 3-4 but rated fourth, up two spots after a 35-21 win at Las Vegas. The offense (+2.5 points) carries them, and the Chargers are next, with the model favoring them by 11.7.

teams.name: Jacksonville Jaguars
teams.note: Jacksonville dropped one spot while on a bye, but still holds an 83% chance at the division. The Colts visit in week 8, and the model has the Jaguars favored by 7.6.

teams.name: Detroit Lions
teams.note: The Lions edged the Packers 20-17 at home, yet slipped a spot to #6. Next up is a home game against the unbeaten Vikings, with Detroit favored by 3.2.

teams.name: Chicago Bears
teams.note: Chicago climbed two spots with a 30-24 win over the Patriots. The offense leads at +1.4 points. Now comes a trip to Seattle, where the model has the Bears as 4.8-point underdogs.

teams.name: Kansas City Chiefs
teams.note: Kansas City fell to #8 after a 20-3 loss in Seattle, but is still 5-1 with a 59% shot at the division. Denver is next, and the model barely favors the Chiefs by 0.2.

teams.name: Minnesota Vikings
teams.note: Minnesota is 6-0 and has won 6 straight, yet sits only ninth. The defense (+2.6 points) is why, while the offense is at -2.0. Next is a trip to Detroit as 3.2-point underdogs.

teams.name: New England Patriots
teams.note: The Patriots held at #10 despite a 30-24 loss in Chicago. Their rating still rose 1.3 points, helped by a +1.7 injury swing. Miami is next, with New England favored by 7.0.

teams.name: Cincinnati Bengals
teams.note: Cincinnati beat Baltimore 35-13 on the road and gained 1.4 rating points, though the rank stayed at #11. Tennessee visits next, and the Bengals are favored by 12.9.

teams.name: Green Bay Packers
teams.note: Green Bay lost 20-17 in Detroit and sits at 4-3 with a -1 point differential. Even so, the rating rose 0.9 points. The Packers face the Patriots in week 9, as 3.1-point underdogs.

teams.name: Tampa Bay Buccaneers
teams.note: Tampa Bay jumped seven spots after a 43-13 win at Carolina. At 2-5 they still hold a 28% chance at the division. Atlanta visits next, with the Bucs favored by 3.0.

teams.name: Denver Broncos
teams.note: Denver has won 3 straight, the latest a 30-16 win over Arizona. The defense is the strength at +1.4 points. Kansas City visits, and the model sees the Broncos as 0.2-point underdogs.

teams.name: Baltimore Ravens
teams.note: Baltimore jumped seven spots despite a 35-13 home loss to Cincinnati, with the quarterback situation worth +4.7 points. Next is a trip to Buffalo, where the Ravens are 6.7-point underdogs.

teams.name: Houston Texans
teams.note: Houston lost 27-21 at home to the Giants and is 2-5. The model rates them 2.4 points lower than the betting market does. The Chargers are next in week 9.

teams.name: Atlanta Falcons
teams.note: Atlanta beat the 49ers 29-20 at home and rose two spots. The offense is the weak spot at -1.4 points. Next is a trip to Tampa Bay, where the Falcons are 3.0-point underdogs.

teams.name: Dallas Cowboys
teams.note: Dallas won 38-21 in Philadelphia and gained 1.4 rating points, but the defense is still the problem at -2.2 points. Arizona visits next, and the Cowboys are favored by 6.9.

teams.name: Pittsburgh Steelers
teams.note: Pittsburgh has won 3 straight, the latest a 16-10 win over New Orleans, yet fell three spots to #19. The offense is at -0.7 points. The Browns visit next, with the Steelers favored by 6.1.

teams.name: Indianapolis Colts
teams.note: Indianapolis has lost 3 straight, the latest a 16-10 loss to Minnesota, and sits at 2-5 with a -26 point differential. Jacksonville is next, with the Colts 7.6-point underdogs.

teams.name: Carolina Panthers
teams.note: Carolina fell eight spots after a 43-13 home loss to Tampa Bay. The scoring margin cost them 1.1 points. Denver visits in week 9, and the model has the Panthers as 0.8-point underdogs.

teams.name: Washington Commanders
teams.note: Washington was on a bye and moved down one spot to #22. At 1-4-1 with a -40 point differential, the defense is the weakest unit at -1.2 points. Philadelphia visits next.

teams.name: New Orleans Saints
teams.note: New Orleans rose three spots despite a 16-10 loss to Pittsburgh. At 2-5 with a 7% playoff chance, the offense is the weak spot at -1.5 points. Cleveland visits in week 9.

teams.name: New York Giants
teams.note: The Giants jumped eight spots after a 27-21 win in Houston, the biggest climb of the week. They are 4-2-1 with a 46% division chance. Next is a trip to Philadelphia in week 9.

teams.name: Cleveland Browns
teams.note: Cleveland is 5-2 with a -13 point differential, and the offense is the weak point at -2.6 points. A 27-24 win at Tennessee lifted them three spots. Pittsburgh is next, with the Browns 6.1-point underdogs.

teams.name: Las Vegas Raiders
teams.note: Las Vegas has lost 4 straight, the latest a 35-21 home loss to the Rams. The offense sits at -1.9 points. Next is a trip to the Jets, with the Raiders 1.7-point underdogs.

teams.name: New York Jets
teams.note: The Jets fell three spots after a 28-25 home loss to Miami. Injuries cost them 1.3 points this week. Las Vegas visits next, with New York favored by 1.7.

teams.name: Los Angeles Chargers
teams.note: The Chargers are 0-6 with a -61 point differential, and have lost 6 straight. Coming off a bye, they face the Rams as 11.7-point underdogs. The offense is at -3.1 points.

teams.name: Arizona Cardinals
teams.note: Arizona is 2-5 with a -66 point differential, the worst on this list. They lost 30-16 to Denver at home. Next is Dallas, where the Cardinals are 6.9-point underdogs.

teams.name: Miami Dolphins
teams.note: Miami won 28-25 over the Jets for its first win beyond a 1-5 start. The rank held at #30. New England visits next, with the Dolphins 7.0-point underdogs.

teams.name: Philadelphia Eagles
teams.note: Philadelphia fell eight spots after a 38-21 home loss to Dallas, its fifth straight defeat. The rating dropped 5.0 points. Next is a trip to Washington as 7.2-point underdogs.

teams.name: Tennessee Titans
teams.note: Tennessee is last at 1-6, with the offense at -3.1 points. A 27-24 home loss to Cleveland dropped them a spot. Cincinnati is next, and the Titans are 12.9-point underdogs.
